lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: combine reservation, arrival, ordering courses, an allergy question, and paying from lessons 1–14 in one ordinary evening
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Get through an ordinary dinner reservation from the host stand to the bill, with one small change along the way.
lessons.title: Midpoint Dinner Review
lessons.objective: Get through an ordinary dinner from reservation to payment: give a reservation under the name Ana for 8 p.m., order soup as a starter and fish with a glass of white wine as a main course, ask about a nut allergy (whether the dish has nuts and whether the same pans are used), accept the chef's nut-free adaptation made in a clean pan, change dessert for fruit, ask for the bill, notice that the tip is not included, and pay by card.

lessons.scene: On an ordinary evening at a French restaurant, Ana arrives at 8 p.m. with a reservation under her name. The waiter seats her and gives her the menu. She orders soup as a starter and fish with a glass of white wine as a main course. Because she is allergic to nuts, she asks whether the dish has nuts and whether the same pans are used. The waiter checks with the chef, who says the dish has nuts but will be made without them, in a clean pan. For dessert, Ana asks to change it for fruit. At the end she asks for the bill, sees that the tip is not included, and pays by card.

cards.fr: J'ai une réservation au nom d'Ana.
cards.en: I have a reservation under the name Ana.

cards.note: In a restaurant, la carte means the menu. Not the same as la carte bancaire.

cards.fr: En entrée, je prends la soupe.
cards.en: As a starter, I'll have the soup.

cards.fr: En plat principal, je prends le poisson avec un verre de vin blanc.
cards.en: For the main course, I'll have the fish with a glass of white wine.

cards.fr: Je suis allergique aux fruits à coque.
Est-ce que ce plat contient des fruits à coque ?
Est-ce que vous utilisez les mêmes poêles ?
cards.en: Do you use the same pans?

cards.fr: Oui, ce plat contient des fruits à coque, mais le chef va le préparer sans fruits à coque, dans une poêle propre.
cards.en: Yes, it has nuts, but the chef is going to make it without nuts, in a clean pan.

cards.fr: Est-ce que je peux remplacer le dessert par des fruits ?
cards.en: Can I change the dessert for fruit?

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous m'apporter l'addition, s'il vous plaît ?
cards.en: Could you bring me the check, please?

cards.fr: Je voudrais payer par carte bancaire.
cards.en: I'd like to pay by card.

cards.note: Common in France for a debit or credit card.

reader.speaker: Narrator
reader.fr: Ana arrive au restaurant à vingt heures.
reader.en: Ana arrives at the restaurant at 8 p.m.

reader.speaker: Ana
reader.fr: Bonsoir. J'ai une réservation au nom d'Ana.
reader.en: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Ana.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Bonsoir, madame. Suivez-moi, votre table est prête. Voici la carte.
reader.en: Good evening, madam. Follow me, your table is ready. Here is the menu.

reader.speaker: Ana
reader.fr: En entrée, je prends la soupe. En plat principal, je prends le poisson avec un verre de vin blanc.
reader.en: As a starter, I'll have the soup. For the main course, I'll have the fish with a glass of white wine.

reader.speaker: Ana
reader.fr: Je suis allergique aux fruits à coque. Est-ce que ce plat contient des fruits à coque ? Et est-ce que vous utilisez les mêmes poêles ?
reader.en: I'm allergic to nuts. Does this dish contain nuts? And do you use the same pans?

reader.speaker: Narrator
reader.fr: Le serveur va voir le chef, puis revient à la table.
reader.en: The waiter goes to see the chef, then comes back to the table.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, ce plat contient des fruits à coque, mais le chef va le préparer sans fruits à coque, dans une poêle propre.
reader.en: Yes, it has nuts, but the chef is going to make it without nuts, in a clean pan.

reader.speaker: Ana
reader.fr: Est-ce que je peux remplacer le dessert par des fruits ?
reader.en: Can I change the dessert for fruit?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Bien sûr, des fruits à la place du dessert, pas de problème.
reader.en: Of course, fruit instead of dessert, no problem.

reader.speaker: Ana
reader.fr: Pourriez-vous m'apporter l'addition, s'il vous plaît ?
reader.en: Could you bring me the check, please?

reader.speaker: Narrator
reader.fr: Ana vérifie l'addition : le pourboire n'est pas compris.
reader.en: Ana checks the bill: the tip is not included.

reader.speaker: Ana
reader.fr: Je voudrais payer par carte bancaire.
reader.en: I'd like to pay by card.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Owner-only draft. The source allergy question and clean-pan adaptation are taught directly. Qualified French and food-domain review remain open. English nuts here follows Spanish nueces and the French fruits à coque; check this lexical scope during qualified review. The source has Ana observe that the tip is not included; the speaking goal follows that sequence.
